species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 65°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 10–38 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 55 ft, cold below.
North wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.
